docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $4,420.75 FILED BY LOCUS, JAMES AS TO DEFENDANT TITCOMBE, PAUL ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR SEP-06-2018 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF SEP-06-2018 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF SEP-06-2018 BY CHRISTINE VAN AKEN. PLAINTIFF WAS PRESENT. DEFENDANT WAS PRESENT AND WAIVES SERVICE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: CHRISTINE VAN AKEN; CLERK: J. BERTELSEN; NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-06-2018 - JUDGMENT.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LOCUS, JAMES RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT TITCOMBE, PAUL $1,776.00 PRINCIPAL, $50.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,826.00, THE COURT IS BOUND BY THE TRO, WHOSE TERMS REQUIRED PLAINTIFF TO LEAVE THE UNIT. THE COURT'S AWARD OF ONE MONTH'S RENT AS DAMAGES REFLECTS PLAINTIFF'S PARTIAL USE OF THE UNIT. THE COURT ALSO OFFSETS THE DAMAGE AWARD TO ACCOUNT FOR THE UTILITIES AND WIFI BILLS THE PARTIES OWE EACH OTHER (PLAINTIFF OWES $260, DEFENDANT OWES $216). STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
